999008199.text:
そうだ、地震で思い出したが
国から調査員が派遣されているんだったな

localizations.en: Oh right, speaking of earthquakes, I remember hearing that the kingdom's sending an investigator to look into them.
Slade

999008199.text:
え、そうなの？
あたし聞いてないんだけど

localizations.en: Huh, really? This is the first I'm hearing about it.
Rias

999008199.text:
やっぱり見逃してたか。
カミラさんからの手紙にあっただろう

localizations.en: Figures you'd miss it. It was in Camilla's letter.
Slade

999008199.text:
ハルフェン群発地震について
国から調査員が派遣されるから、会ったらよろしくと

localizations.en: She said the kingdom's dispatching an investigator to look into the earthquake swarms in Hallfein, and to treat them well if we run into them.
Slade

999008199.text:
あー、そういえば……なんか難しいから
読み飛ばしてたかも、てへ

localizations.en: Oh yeah, now that you mention it... I might've skimmed over that part because it looked complicated, ahaha.
Rias

999008199.text:
まったく……まあ、こういう事態を見越して
俺がいるんだけどな

localizations.en: Honestly... Well, this is exactly why I'm here—to handle situations like this.
Slade

999008199.text:
大樹の実についてもなんとかしたいが
まずはこの地震について調査しないか？

localizations.en: I'd like to figure out the fruit situation too, but shouldn't we investigate these earthquakes first?
Slade

999008199.text:
賛成！　今はまだ小さいけど、
もし大地震が起きたら復興やり直しだし！

localizations.en: Agreed! They're small now, but if a big one hits, we'll have to start the restoration all over again!
Rias

999008199.text:
でも調査って、具体的には
何をどーすればいいの？

localizations.en: But what exactly do we do?
Rias

999008199.text:
そうだな……鉱山を確認しに行かないか？
崩落の危険性や兆候がないかを調査するんだ

localizations.en: Good question... How about we check out the mines? We can investigate whether there are any signs of danger or potential cave-ins.
Slade

999008199.text:
あー、仕事中に地震が起きて
出口が塞がれちゃったりしたら大変だもんね

localizations.en: Oh yeah, it'd be terrible if an earthquake hit while people were working and blocked the exits.
Rias

999008199.text:
手紙にあった国からの調査員も
鉱山を調査しているそうだし、挨拶をしておこう

localizations.en: The investigator from the kingdom that was mentioned in the letter is apparently surveying the mines too, so we should go introduce ourselves.
Slade

999008199.text: もちろん、この鉱山調査自体にも危険が伴うが……

localizations.en: Of course, there are risks involved with investigating the mines themselves...
Slade

999008199.text:
よし、そうと決まったらぷには急げ！
しゅっぱーつ！

localizations.en: All right, then there's no time to waste! Let's get going!
Rias

999008199.text: やれやれ、こういうところは変わらないな……

localizations.en: Good grief, some things never change...
Slade

999008199.text: だって、いざってときは守ってくれるでしょ？

localizations.en: What? You'll protect me if things get dicey, won't you?
Rias

999008199.text: ああ。お前のことは俺が守るよ

localizations.en: Yeah. I'll always keep you safe.
Slade

999008199.text:
ふふ。国から派遣された調査員って人も気になるし！
どんな人なんだろうね？

localizations.en: Hehe. I'm curious about this investigator from the kingdom too! I wonder what they're like?
Rias

999008199.text:
カミラさんからの手紙には書かれていなかったが、
国からの推薦ともなれば、当然凄腕の学者だろうな

localizations.en: Camilla's letter didn't say, but if they were recommended by the kingdom, they must be a highly skilled scholar.
Slade

999008199.text:
エルみたいなかわいい子だったらいいな～
あー、久しぶりにエルの耳をわしわししたいな～

localizations.en: I hope they're as cute as El! Ahhh, I wanna give El's ears a good rub again!
Rias

999008199.text: 初対面で失礼なことをしないようにな

localizations.en: Try not to be rude when you first meet them.
Slade

999008199.text:
はーい、分かってまーす！
さ、行こ！　改めて……しゅっぱーつ！

localizations.en: Yeah, yeah, I know! Now come on, let's go! For real this time... Let's get going!
Rias
